thread:
incident-bot: :loud_sound: Pager triggered: service=inference-gateway severity=high — 5xx rate spike detected in eu-west1.

pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026-342 fired, triggered by alert: inference-gateway.5xx_rate > 5% for 3m.

sre-jordan: acked. oncall-lee, you're on rotation — can you take lead?

oncall-lee: I'm on it. see dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/gw/dashboards/5xx-rate?tz=UTC

eng-runtime-alice: I'm seeing 502s mainly on long-run requests to model-redwood-7b. pattern: conn resets + upstream timeouts.

eng-sre-bob: checking k8s pods in eu-west1. `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-gw -o wide` shows a few OOMKilled pods last 10m.

oncall-lee: any customer-facing 5xx errors? product-carol?

product-carol: support flagged ~3 customers in EU with elevated error rates. no major revenue impact flagged yet, but spikes correlate with evening traffic.

eng-runtime-alice: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T19:53:12Z [warn] upstream reset: conn reset by peer
2026-03-15T19:53:14Z [error] request failed: model backend 10.10.5.23:504 timeout
2026-03-15T19:53:20Z [info] kv-cache miss warmup triggered
```

eng-sre-bob: metric dump: 5xx rate went 1.2% -> 7.8% in 8 minutes; p50 latency steady, p95 increased ~150ms.

oncall-lee: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-secondary 2) increase replica count for inference-gw 3) disable non-critical canary. Doing step 1 now.

oncall-lee: `rgwctl route set --service inference-gateway --region eu --fallback eu-secondary` -> applied.

monitoring-bot: Alert: routing-change applied by oncall-lee at 2026-03-15T19:58:10Z.

eng-runtime-alice: stepping up replicas via HPA manual scale: `kubectl scale deploy inference-gw --replicas=12 -n inference` (was 6). kicking off.

sre-jordan: good. I'll watch the pod restart churn. if we see OOM again, we'll roll a config with smaller concurrency per-worker.

eng-sre-bob: noticed memory pressure on nodes: some pods scheduled on older instance type (r5a-like). moving new pods to gpu-backed pools may help for model backends.

oncall-lee: temporary rate-limit to protect backend? set per-customer soft quota to 10rps for EU traffic.

product-carol: coordinating customer comms. I'll send a short note to impacted accounts: "We're investigating elevated error rates; mitigation in progress."

duty-dave: is this possibly related to the new quantized model roll we did overnight? rollout id rl-2026-03-15-quant1

eng-runtime-alice: good catch — canary was enabled for 10% EU traffic earlier today. I am disabling canary now: `deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-15-quant1 --scope eu`

monitoring-bot: Canary rollback initiated by eng-runtime-alice.

eng-sre-bob: after scaling and rollback, 5xx rate dropped to 3.4% at 20:02 UTC. still above baseline.

oncall-lee: rerouting + scale + rollback seems to reduce error rate. keeping pages open until below 1%.

eng-runtime-alice: running lightweight KV cache warmup script to reduce backend cold starts — `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --region eu --prefix /models/redwood/*`

pagerduty: Reminder: if not acknowledged by primary in 5m, escalation to oncall-lee -> duty-dave.

sre-jordan: creating incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-342 with initial notes and runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/5xx-spike

product-carol: update to customers sent. no escalations yet.

eng-sre-bob: Observability: traces show a subset of failures coming from a noisy upstream (model backend 10.10.5.23). isolating that host. marking as unhealthy in LB.

eng-runtime-alice: `lbctl remove-backend --ip 10.10.5.23 --service model-embedder` -> done. traffic redistributed.

monitoring-bot: Backend 10.10.5.23 removed by eng-runtime-alice. New health status: healthy_backends=9/10.

oncall-lee: 5xx rate now 0.9% and trending down. I'm going to start the page close checklist.

sre-jordan: runbook step: verify customers, confirm rollback, ensure autoscaling stabilized.

product-carol: filing a follow-up with CSMs; will prepare internal blameless postmortem starter.

oncall-lee: closing primary PagerDuty alert as mitigation succeeded. leaving incident ticket open for post-incident follow-up.

pagerduty: Alert resolved by oncall-lee at 2026-03-15T20:10:00Z.

eng-runtime-alice: notes for postmortem: root cause likely combo of noisy backend + canary quant model increasing memory footprints causing OOMs under evening spike. action items: stricter canary isolation, mem cap in worker, better upstream health checks, auto-removal of unhealthy backends.

sre-jordan: assigning action items: 1) eng-runtime to add mem caps (alice) 2) infra to add auto-backend-bail (bob) 3) product to update customer comms template (carol).

product-carol: I'll own the comms template and coordinate customer follow-ups.

oncall-lee: thanks team. closing thread, will hand to postmortem owner. :thumbsup:
